messages:
Jen (PM): Quick sync — proposing a fallthrough strategy for compatibility failures during model intake. TL;DR: prefer degraded-but-safe path over hard reject for minor mismatches. Thoughts?

Maria (ML): +1 to degraded path for NLP-only regressions (tokenization, small shape diffs). Hard reject for weight/format corruption.

Kevin (Infra): Agree but we need guardrails to avoid runtime surprises. If we allow fallthrough, we must tag the model variant and route only canary traffic. Also need disk/quota checks before anything.

Sanjay (Runtime): Important: KV-cache layout differences are tricky. If we fallthrough to a runtime-compatible shim, add a runtime flag that forces full warmup & checksum on first N requests. Otherwise cold misses will blow latency.

Oliver (Bench): Bench perspective: allow fallthrough only when perf regressions <= 5% on p50 and p99 on our small-suite. If bigger, auto-quarantine. We can run the small-suite in ~8m.

Jen (PM): Proposed policy sketch:
1) Reject: schema/format corrupt, missing weights, unsupported ops.
2) Quarantine: larger perf regressions (>5%) or failing critical evals.
3) Fallthrough (degraded): minor tokenization mismatch, noncritical dtype promos, small shape heuristics — allow with canary+tagging+observability.

Maria (ML): Need to call out eval regression triggers — e.g., spam-score delta > 0.04 or QA F1 drop > 0.02. We can encode these as checks in the intake manifest.

Kevin (Infra): Operational hooks: when fallthrough happens, auto-create a routing policy:
```
route: canary
percent: 5
fallback: stable-variant
monitoring: intake-fallthrough:<model>:<ver>
```
Make percent configurable per-customer.

Sanjay (Runtime): Implementation note: shim vs fallback variant. Two options: runtime shim performs on-the-fly conversion (fast but risky), or we downgrade to a known-compatible quantized variant (safer). Prefer variant fallback unless conversion is proven.

Oliver (Bench): We should add a micro-benchmark that focuses on cache-warmup & kv-behavior. Small-suite misses won't catch warmup path regressions. Add 2-min warmup test.

Jen (PM): Decision (tentative): prefer variant fallback + canary routing for fallthrough; allow runtime shim only behind strict opt-in and additional warmup checks. Action items: Maria -> sketch eval thresholds; Oliver -> add warmup micro-bench; Kevin -> routing + quota guard; Sanjay -> runtime flag & shim gating.

Maria (ML): I'll drop a PR with thresholds and example manifest by EOD. :+1:

Oliver (Bench): I'll add the warmup test to small-suite CI and a dashboard tile. ETA 2 working days. :rocket:

Kevin (Infra): Will add routing template and quota pre-checks. Also adding audit log entry for fallthrough decisions.

Sanjay (Runtime): I'll prototype a shim gating flag and the first-request warmup checksum flow.

OnboardBot: Automated intake run started for model 'elektra-3b' (ver 2026-03-19). Status: pending small-suite. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/7890

Jen (PM): Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if the PRs find edge cases. For now this is our working strategy. :eyes:
